chunks: Safwan, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

The foot of the thief is cut after the cutting of the hand; then after that he is not cut again. If he returns [to theft], he is imprisoned in the prison and provided for from the Bayt al-Mal of the Muslims.

key_terms.السَّارِقِ: the thief; the person guilty of theft
key_terms.السِّجْنِ: the prison; the place of confinement
key_terms.بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the public treasury of the Muslims; communal funds from which his maintenance is provided
key_terms.تُقْطَعُ: is cut; indicating the prescribed corporal punishment
key_terms.حُبِسَ: he is imprisoned; confined after repeating the offense again
key_terms.رِجْلُ: foot; the limb cut after the hand in the ruling mentioned

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a repeat thief after the hand and foot have already been cut?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning repeated theft: after the hand is cut, the foot is cut, and no further cutting is carried out thereafter. If the thief repeats the offense again, he is imprisoned and maintained from the public treasury of the Muslims.
